notes.title: English Version Kickstarter! Announcing the Visual Novel Fest and Free DLC!
notes.notes:
Look up "Black Lily's Tale" on Kickstarter!
The Kickstarter for the English version of Hayasaki no Kuroyuri has been launched!
To make it a reality, we would be so grateful for your interest!

The Visual Novel Fest has started!
The main story and DLC will have a discount of up to 40%, so be sure to add them to your wishlist!
*This is a greater discount than in usual Fests!

Moreover, we are introducing free DLC "Hana and Itsuki's After-Story 3"!
It comes with scene illustrations and voice acting, so don't miss this opportunity!

***What is Black Lily's Tale?***
Delicate and beautiful illustrations made by acclaimed artist Fukahire.
A system of choices to change the course of the story, complete with interruptions and word input.

Pure but not naïve, classic but not cliché.
A yuri game that will make you strive towards the best ending.
A colorful tale that lets you bring happiness to the cast of female characters.
